items.raw_excerpt: The aging Macquarie Wharf 6 on Hobart's waterfront is being dismantled as part of a project to deliver a modern home port for RSV Nuyina.

items.title_original: Hobart wharf demolition paving way for new icebreaker berth

items.raw_excerpt: Jetstar Australia will start charging passengers for the use of overhead luggage bins from February next year.
items.summary_en: Jetstar Australia will start charging passengers for using overhead luggage bins. The new fee begins in February next year. This applies to carry-on bags stored in overhead lockers.

items.raw_excerpt: With her palms pressed together and her head bowed, Wassana Nak-umma vowed to give up alcohol for three months, joining millions of Thais in an abstinence campaign blending public health with spirituality.
items.summary_en: Wassana Nak-umma bowed her head and promised to stop drinking alcohol for three months. She joins millions of Thais taking part in an abstinence campaign. The campaign mixes public health with Buddhist tradition.

items.raw_excerpt: A parliamentary committee has handed down its findings after an investigation into a Newcastle hospital where staff reported maggots falling from the ceiling.
items.summary_en: A parliamentary committee finished its inquiry into a Newcastle hospital. Staff there said maggots fell from the ceiling. The committee wants the hospital's public-private partnership ended.
items.summary_ko: 의회 조사단이 뉴캐슬 병원 조사를 마치고 결과를 발표했다. 병원 직원들은 천장에서 구더기가 떨어진다고 보고했다. 조사단은 병원의 민관 협력 계약을 중단하라고 권고했다.

items.raw_excerpt: Làng nghề điêu khắc đá mỹ nghệ Non Nước được coi là làng nghề lâu đời và nổi tiếng nhất Đà Nẵng. Với những định hướng quy hoạch mới của thành phố, làng nghề trong thời gian tới sẽ có bước phát triển đột phá, tiếp tục mang lại giá trị kinh tế - xã hội to lớn cho địa phương.

items.raw_excerpt: Calls for Haryana to co-host the 2030 Commonwealth Games grow after its athletes excelled at the recent CWG in Glasgow.
items.summary_en: People in the Indian state of Haryana are asking the state to co-host the 2030 Commonwealth Games. Their push comes after Haryana athletes performed well at the recent Games in Glasgow.

items.summary_en: Two priority-use gantries at Punggol Coast MRT station now have screens installed. A facial recognition detection zone is marked on the ground. The Land Transport Authority says there are no plans to expand the trial for now.

items.raw_excerpt: Filipino baker Reynaldo Herboso and nine friends chipped in to buy lottery tickets together for 15 years and their persistence finally paid off after securing a Dh20 million (US$5.4 million) jackpot in Abu Dhabi's Big Ticket draw.
items.summary_en: Reynaldo Herboso and nine friends bought lottery tickets together for 15 years. Their patience paid off with a $5.4 million win in Abu Dhabi's Big Ticket draw. The group will share the prize money.

items.title_original: Filipino baker and 9 friends win $5.4M jackpot after 15 years of buying lottery tickets together

items.raw_excerpt: A 4-year-old boy in Terengganu, Malaysia, brought a durian to gift his kindergarten teacher on her last day at the school despite that fact that he cannot stand the smell of the fruit.
items.summary_en: A 4-year-old boy in Terengganu, Malaysia brought a durian to school. He wanted to give it to his kindergarten teacher as a farewell gift on her last day. He cannot stand the smell of the fruit.

items.raw_excerpt: The WA waste authority has quietly changed the rules on what can go in green-lidded bins in a move councils say is likely to confuse many people still adapting to the new system.
items.summary_en: Western Australia changed the rules for green-lidded bins without telling people first. Dog poo and tea bags are no longer allowed in them. Councils say many residents may be confused as they are still learning the new system.
items.summary_ko: 웨스턴오스트레일리아 주 폐기물 당국이 초록색 뚜껑 쓰레기통에 넣을 수 있는 품목 규칙을 조용히 바꿨다. 이제 개 배설물과 티백은 버릴 수 없다. 시의회는 새 시스템에 아직 적응 중인 많은 주민이 혼란을 겪을 수 있다고 우려한다.
items.title_en: Western Australia quietly changes green bin rules, bans dog poo and tea bags
items.title_ko: 웨스턴오스트레일리아, 초록 쓰레기통에 개 배설물·티백 금지
items.title_original: No dog poo or tea bags in surprise change to WA FOGO bin rules

items.raw_excerpt: Most of these districts rank among Karnataka’s lowest on the Human Development Index (HDI), according to the Govind Rao Committee report on regional imbalances released earlier this year.
items.summary_en: A state report on Karnataka's electoral rolls says 16 districts are mostly backward. These districts rank among the lowest in the state on the Human Development Index. Over 12 percent of voters in them fall under ASDDO.

items.title_en: Karnataka report: 16 mostly backward districts have over 12 percent voters under ASDDO
items.title_ko: 카르나타카주 낙후 지역 16개 지구, 유권자의 12% 넘게 ASDDO 대상
items.title_original: Karnataka SIR: 16 districts, mostly backward, report over 12% voters under ASDDO

items.summary_en: Singapore's deposit scheme collected 5.5 million drink containers since April. Deposits not redeemed by consumers may help pay the scheme's costs. The program started on April 1.

items.summary_en: The Recife metro stopped the Center Line on Tuesday. The operator CBTU blamed operational problems and a reduced fleet. Bus companies added more buses to serve passengers.
